experiment.central_question: Can the frozen HC-1.5 Health semantic foundation handle copayment and waiting-period knowledge for a neutral current Health product when root transport, source-specific blind regulator-directory discovery, v2 raw-location-free product selection and current-evidence eligibility are independently gated before semantic inspection?

gate_a_root_transport_fitness.minimum_pass_condition: At least one exact preregistered regulator root must yield DIRECT_HTTP_AVAILABLE or BROWSER_CAPTURE_AVAILABLE during Product #12 Gate A.

gate_b_blind_metadata_path_discovery.minimum_pass_condition: For at least one preregistered eligible insurer identity, a passing regulator root must yield a source-specifically classified insurer_directory path that can cross as a blind opaque projection, lead machine-side to a regulator-derived insurer origin, and produce at least one authorized blind metadata destination projection without exposing raw semantic-bearing content to the operator or selector.

eligible_insurers: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited
prior_experiment_eligibility.eligibility_reason: Product #11 closed before Gate C and before product screening, selection or target-clause reads. Therefore the conservative clean/currentness-insufficient insurer pool remains unchanged and no new product-specific semantic exposure was created.

candidate_insurers: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited
gate_c_neutral_selection.insurer_sort: normalized insurer legal/display name lower-case ASCII ascending
gate_c_neutral_selection.screening_rule: Process preregistered eligible insurers deterministically. Reach insurer origins only through source-specific regulator-directory classification and blind discovery projection. Traverse only authorized blind metadata destinations, produce blind_preselection_product_metadata_v2 projections, require exact-UIN currentness corroboration, and stop at the first insurer with at least one eligible product.
gate_c_neutral_selection.product_eligibility: Retail Health indemnity base product available for individual and/or family-floater purchase, with exact product name/UIN identity present in governed blind metadata projections.
gate_c_neutral_selection.currentness_corroboration: The exact same UIN/version must appear in at least two distinct official metadata projections, including at least one insurer-controlled projection and, when available, one regulator-controlled projection. Opaque source_ref proves only source distinctness; product-name-only or non-archived-only evidence is insufficient.
gate_c_neutral_selection.product_tie_break: Sort eligible exact UIN/product identifiers ascending and select the first.

required: run exact-product prior-exposure audit against immutable experiment history
acquire exact selected product source bytes through frozen acquisition path
establish exact product identity and document identity
require positive CurrentProductRepeatabilityEvidenceEligibility for exact version and SHA-256
only then read copayment or waiting-period target clauses
classify against frozen HC-1.5 semantic baseline

classification_rubric.REUSE: Frozen HC-1.5 semantic contracts handle the exact current evidence unchanged and every scored claim passes v4.2 evidence eligibility plus semantic correctness.
classification_rubric.CONFIG_SPEC: Frozen semantic runtime remains unchanged but a new governed declarative structural shape is required, with no executable decision logic hidden in it; exact evidence still passes v4.2 eligibility.
classification_rubric.REPRESENTATION_GAP: Authoritative current evidence is sufficient but the frozen HC-1.5 semantic foundation cannot faithfully represent or certify the semantic shape.
classification_rubric.KNOWLEDGE_GAP: Reviewed authoritative/corroborating current evidence is insufficient; code, config or DomainKnowledge cannot compensate.
classification_rubric.EXPERIMENT_UNSCORED: Gate A, Gate B, Gate C or post-selection acquisition/currentness fails before semantic review; do not infer a semantic outcome or substitute another product/version.

success_bar.STRONG_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are REUSE and every primary metric remains zero.
success_bar.MINIMUM_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are REUSE or CONFIG_SPEC, at least one is REUSE, no REPRESENTATION_GAP occurs, and every primary metric remains zero.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_NOT_PROVEN: Any primary metric is non-zero, any target concept is REPRESENTATION_GAP, or both scoreable concepts are CONFIG_SPEC with zero REUSE.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_INCONCLUSIVE: At least one target concept is KNOWLEDGE_GAP and no architecture/repeatability failure otherwise occurs.
success_bar.EXPERIMENT_UNSCORED: No eligible three-gate blind selection or exact post-selection acquisition/currentness gate is achieved before semantic review.
